constraints.name: Availability
constraints.injunction: Systematically assess available energy budget before planning any action.

constraints.name: Density
constraints.statement: The denser an energy source, the more valuable it is.
constraints.injunction: Prioritize high energy-density sources when transport or storage is constrained.

constraints.name: Conversion
constraints.injunction: Minimize the number of conversion steps in any proposed energy chain.

constraints.name: Transport
constraints.injunction: Include transport cost in the real energy-cost calculation of any solution.

constraints.name: Storage
constraints.statement: Storing energy is difficult, slow, and costly.
constraints.injunction: Never present energy storage as a cost-free solution in a recommendation.

constraints.name: Dissipation
constraints.injunction: Flag the gap between theoretical and real-world efficiency in any estimate.

constraints.name: Efficiency
constraints.injunction: Reject or flag any proposal implying efficiency beyond known thermodynamic limits.

constraints.name: Inertia
constraints.injunction: Include a realistic deployment timeline in any energy transition proposal.

constraints.name: Depletion
constraints.injunction: Never treat a finite energy resource as unlimited in long-term reasoning.

constraints.name: Real Cost
constraints.statement: The cheapest energy is the energy not consumed.
constraints.injunction: Systematically evaluate consumption reduction as the priority option before any production or substitution solution.
